titleEn: A Hole in the Stone Wall

pages.text: Wind whistled all night. In the morning, one corner of the stone wall had fallen down.
It would be trouble if sheep escaped through the hole. "I will close it." Pipo picked up a fallen stone.
Mr. Horse came striding over. "Building walls has to be quick, quick!"
He lifted the biggest stone and set it on the hole with a thump.
Another on top, then another. The stones piled up crookedly.
Wobble—crash! All the stones rolled down.
"Oh, my foot!" He clutched the top of his foot and hopped.
Pipo chose small stones first. He fitted them firmly into the gaps, one by one.
When Mr. Horse set big stones on top, they settled snugly. The wall did not wobble.
The hole was completely hidden. Mr. Horse gave the wall a little push and nodded. "...Solid."
